outcome: composite adverse perinatal outcomes (APO) (cesarean or operative vaginal delivery due to pathological CTG, 5-min Apgar <7, umbilical artery pH <7.1 and/or base excess >12mmol/L, or NICU admission)
objective APO (composite APO excluding operative delivery for pathological CTG)
cohort: 395 healthy term pregnant women were enrolled, with 307 women with spontaneous labor included in the analysis after excluding those undergoing labor induction.
finding: Maternal hemodynamic assessment (SVR >1,135dynscm-5) and cCTG (STV <=7ms), along with parity, performed before labor, are independent predictors that may improve the identification of women at increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
